function.name: uber_eat_order
function.description: Place an order for food delivery on Uber Eats by specifying the restaurant and the items with their respective quantities. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

restaurant.description: The name of the restaurant from which to order food.

items.description: A list of food item names selected for the order.

quantities.description: A list of quantities for each food item, corresponding by index to the items array.

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to live weather data. To find out the current temperature in Riga, you could check a reliable weather website (e.g., Weather.com, AccuWeather, or the National Meteorological Service) or use a weather app on your phone. If you’d like, I can help you set up a quick script that pulls the current temperature from an API like OpenWeatherMap. Just let me know!
message.reasoning: The user asks: "How hot is it now in Riga?" They want current temperature. We need to provide weather info. We don't have real-time data. We can respond that we can't fetch live data. We can suggest using a weather API or website. We can also provide approximate typical temperature. But better to say we can't provide real-time.
